title: Gator Painters vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Comparing Gator Painters and Precision Paint Experts for a deck or fence? What to ask about wood prep, stain type, and coverage before you choose a crew.
h1: Gator Painters vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Decks and fences take more sun and rain than any painted wall. Here's how to weigh one staining bid against another before you hand over your backyard.

sections.h2: Wood outdoors is a different job
body: You may have Gator Painters on your list of companies to call about the backyard. When the work is a deck, a fence, a pergola, or any other wood left out in the weather, the bid calls for questions you wouldn't ask about a wall. Horizontal deck boards take direct sun and standing water, fence pickets get splashed by sprinklers and soaked by storms, and both expand and shrink every day. A coating that works on a wall may not last a season on a deck.

This page leaves other businesses out of it and looks at methods instead. It explains why product type matters so much on exterior wood, what to check before anyone opens a can, and which questions help you line up staining bids on equal terms. The same questions apply whether you are refreshing a small back porch or a long perimeter fence.

Film-forming coatings build a skin over the boards. Out in the open on a flat deck, that skin holds water underneath and eventually lifts, leaving a patchy deck that has to be stripped before it can be redone. Penetrating stains soak into the wood fibers instead, so as they weather they fade rather than flake, which makes the next maintenance coat much simpler.

On bare outdoor wood, our crews apply a penetrating stain from a premium line, and the quote tells you which one. After spraying, a painter follows with a brush, pushing stain down into the grain and between boards so it doesn't just sit on top. The complete deck process is on our deck and fence staining page, and pergolas, siding, and other outdoor wood fall under wood staining and finishing. We back-brush every sprayed board.

sections.h2: Checking the wood before you stain
body: Stain will not fix soft or rotting boards. Before you collect bids, walk the deck and press on boards near the house, around posts, and at stair stringers. For the warning signs, read signs of deck wood rot; if the pickets have gone gray and dry, our piece on treating a sun-damaged fence is the place to start.

When we visit, the crew lead photographs the deck and fence and puts a moisture meter on any boards that look questionable, so problem spots show up on the quote instead of surprising everyone mid-job.

sections.h2: Deck and fence questions for every bidder
bullets: What product will be used, and is it a penetrating stain or a film-forming coating?
How will the wood be cleaned and prepared?
Are railings, stairs, and the underside of handrails included?
Will damaged boards be flagged and priced separately?
How many coats go on, and how does the stain get worked into the grain?

Our region's October-to-May exterior window happens to be ideal for staining too. Summer decks and fences can still be done in the morning hours, with an eye on dew point and the radar. Your free quote names the boards and structures included and excluded, the prep, the product, and the coat count, and it's typically in hand a business day after the walkthrough.

Leave room for weather in your plans. Stain only goes onto dry wood, which means a rainy stretch can bump the start date. Ask every bidder how they decide the wood is ready, and get that standard in writing.

faqs.q: For a deck in this climate, should I choose stain or paint?
faqs.a: On bare, weather-exposed boards we choose a penetrating stain. It absorbs into the wood and wears by fading instead of peeling, so re-coating later is far easier.

faqs.q: What happens if some deck boards are rotten?
faqs.a: The crew lead flags them on the walkthrough and they appear as separate items on your quote, letting you choose which repairs to make before any stain goes on.

faqs.q: Does Precision Paint Experts have any tie to Gator Painters?
faqs.a: No. We're an independent, locally owned business, and this page simply walks through how to compare staining proposals.
